child_list.content: The turtle and the rabbit
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
One day, a turtle and a rabbit were running in a race. The rabbit said to the turtle, “I run fast. You run slow. I will win at last.” The turtle answered, “I know you run faster than me. But I will try my best.” The race began. At first, the rabbit ran as fast as he could. After a while, the rabbit thought he would win so he

stopped to sleep. But the turtle ran and ran. Finally he reached the end. The turtle shouted excitedly, “I win!” The rabbit found the turtle won the race. He was very shocked, but it was too late.

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

child_list.content: 龟兔赛跑
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
一天，一只乌龟和一只兔子在赛跑。兔子对乌龟说：“我跑得快。你跑得慢。最后我会赢。”乌龟回答说：“我知道你跑得比我更快。但我会全力以赴的。”

比赛开始了。 刚开始，兔子拼命跑。过了一会儿，兔子认为他会赢，所以他停下来睡觉。但是乌龟跑啊跑。最后他到达终点。乌龟激动地大喊：“我赢了！”兔子发现乌龟赢了比赛。 他非常震惊，但已经太迟了。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
